Subtraction as ungrouping

Two numbers, one above the other. Subtracting takes the lower counters away from the upper ones in each column, starting at the right. When a column is short, press Unbundle to trade one counter from the next column for a full bundle: the borrow.

1 · Counters, one column at a time

2 · The same trades, in digits

This is the written method, following the buttons above. A crossed-out digit has been traded away; the dashed box above it shows what the column holds now. The small 1 is the bundle that arrived from the left.
